mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization, then registration with the Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR); apostille required only if the deed is executed by a foreign parent under foreign law

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Luxembourg Business Registers – Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Luxembourg Register of Beneficial Owners (RBE) operated by LBR

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (1961 Convention states) OR Consular Legalization at a Luxembourg embassy/consulate for non-Hague states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Conduct / Police Clearance Certificate (extrait de casier judiciaire) for the General Partner and senior manager
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Luxembourg Ministry of Justice or equivalent foreign criminal-records authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization as required by country of issuance

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Luxembourg credit institution or reputable foreign bank
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Banker's internal verification and LBR/original-seal authentication (no apostille; bank-to-bank confirmation accepted)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed Luxembourg domiciliation agent (Law of 31 May 1999)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Contractual execution under Luxembourg civil law (no apostille)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory onboarding screening of all UBOs, directors, general partners and material counterparties against: (1) EU Consolidated Sanctions List (CFSP), (2) UN Security Council sanctions lists, (3) OFAC SDN and sectoral sanctions list (mandatory for USD-denominated revolving LCs and SWIFT TT), (4) Luxembourg FIU (CRF) guidance and CSSF warning lists, (5) FATF public statements and grey-list jurisdictions. PEP determination follows FATF Recommendation 12 and the Law of 12 November 2004 Article 1bis; any PEP status triggers Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), source-of-wealth verification, and senior management approval. Continuous screening is required throughout the banking relationship, particularly on each LC issuance and amendment under the target payment rails.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) – Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), online portal www.lbr.lu
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Statutory filings are made in French; the corporate name must use the Latin alphabet and be legible to the RCS. Names in non-Latin scripts (e.g., Chinese characters) must be transliterated into French/Latin script in the deed and all commercial documentation; the transliterated version becomes the official registered name for invoicing, customs, and VAT purposes.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The notary obtains the RCS Certificate of Non-Confusion before deed execution. If the RCS rejects the name on grounds of confusion, public order, or a prohibited token, the notary files a reasoned demand for reconsideration with the RCS Registry within one month; in case of maintained rejection, an administrative appeal is lodged before the Luxembourg District Court (Tribunal d'arrondissement de Luxembourg, chambre commerciale) pursuant to the Law of 19 December 2002 on the register of commerce and companies and the Law of 2 September 2011 on trade names; the court assesses likelihood of confusion and compliance with the Law of 10 August 1915 on commercial companies.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted as sole substance. The SCSp must maintain a registered office in Luxembourg (Law of 10 August 1915, Article 110-1). Professional domiciliation through a licensed 'domiciliataire' under the Law of 31 May 1999 is permitted and commonly used. However, for an active cold-chain import and wholesale trading company (ISIC 4632), the SCSp must establish real operational substance: local management decisions, contractual logistics and cold-storage arrangements, accounting records, and customs/VAT registration. Reliance on a pure mail-forwarding virtual office will not satisfy ACD economic-substance expectations and may be challenged under EU ATAD/Substance Directive standards.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 20-30% probability within the first 24 months of operation. Unannounced physical inspections may be triggered by the Luxembourg direct tax administration (ACD) economic-substance audits, customs veterinary and food-control checks under Regulation (EU) 2017/625 (cold-chain and animal-origin imports), VAT fraud screenings, and FIU follow-up inspections. Probability increases above 35% if the registered office is a shared domiciliation address without verifiable local management presence.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies, as amended; Articles 944-1 to 944-36 (Société en Commandite Spéciale / SCSp)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) — Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Acte constitutif (contrat de société) and RCS filing request lodged via the RCS electronic platform
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital; no paid-up capital or escrow account requirement. The contribution obligations are freely determined in the partnership agreement.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) The founding partners approve the acte constitutif and partnership agreement of the SCSp, confirming the subscribed capital contributions and profit-sharing percentages described therein. (2) The registered office of the SCSp is fixed at [address in Luxembourg] and the filing of the formation deed with the RCS is hereby authorized. (3) [Name] and [Name] are appointed gérant(s), each acting individually, with authority to open bank accounts, sign orders and contracts, and carry out all transactions relating to the import of frozen meat and seafood products. (4) All pre-registration costs are ratified; the gérant(s) are instructed to complete any required RCS filings, commercial establishment authorization, and food business operator registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) via Luxembourg Business Registers online portal (lbr.lu)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request to verify that the proposed SCSp name does not conflict with existing Luxembourg entities. Once cleared, the name may be held pending registration.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name
Identification documents of founding partners
Short description of the intended corporate object
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RCS refuses the name on grounds of confusion or public policy, the applicant may either select a revised name and resubmit a new application, or appeal the decision before the competent commercial court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the Partnership Agreement / Acte Constitutif
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary public and/or all founding partners executing the deed by private signature; notarial deed mandatory where real property is contributed.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The founding partners or their legal representatives must fully execute the acte constitutif and the SCSp partnership agreement, including capital contributions, profit-sharing, management powers, and registered office details.
required_dossiers: Draft partnership agreement and acte constitutif
Passport or national identity card of each founding partner
Proof of residential address of each partner
Name reservation certificate
Manager(s) signed letter of acceptance
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a notary or a partner identifies a defect in the deed, the parties may execute an addendum or re-execute the corrected deed. Any amendment must be reflected before RCS submission to avoid post-filing rectifications.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: RCS Registration and Filing of the Formation Deed
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) via MyGuichet.lu or the RCS e-filing system
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the executed acte constitutif and the RCS form for new company registration within one month of execution. The system will assign a RCS registration number and issue a legalized extract after validation and fee payment.
required_dossiers: Signed and dated acte constitutif
Completed RCS registration form
Statement of acceptance by each appointed gérant
Identity documents and criminal records of gérants
Proof of registered office address (lease agreement, sublease, or notarized authorization)
Power of attorney if filing through a representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Should the RCS issue a query, the filer has 15 days to cure. The response must include the corrected deed or missing supporting documents. A formal appeal against an RCS refusal may be brought before the district court (tribunal d'arrondissement).

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication in the Official Electronic Gazette RESA
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) / Recueil Électronique des Sociétés et Associations (RESA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After RCS validation, the formation details are automatically transmitted for publication in the RESA. The publication is organized by the RCS and gives legal effect against third parties.
required_dossiers: RCS registration extract
Formation details as accepted by the RCS
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RESA publication contains errors, the filer may request a corrective notice through the RCS. If third-party rights are affected, a court action for rectification or annulment may be necessary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministère de l'Économie — Direction Générale de l'Autorisation d'Établissement via MyGuichet.lu
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an establishment authorization application on behalf of the SCSp. Because the registered business is wholesale importation of foodstuffs, the appointed gérant(s) must demonstrate good character and the required professional competence for the commercial activity.
required_dossiers: Completed government establishment authorization form
Certificate of good conduct (criminal record) for the gérant(s)
Proof of professional qualifications or experience in the sector
RCS registration extract of the SCSp
Partnership agreement
Description of the import and wholesale activities
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Ministry requires additional evidence or refuses the authorization, the applicant may correct the dossier and re-submit or file an appeal with the Administrative Tribunal (Tribunal Administratif) within 3 months of notification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Food Business Operator Registration and Cold-Chain Compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File a food business operator (FBO) notification with ALVA for the importation and wholesale distribution of deep-frozen meat and fishery products. Implement HACCP-based controls and ensure that each imported consignment meets EU hygiene and veterinary import regulations.
required_dossiers: FBO registration form
Description of the cold-chain warehouse or outsourced storage arrangements
HACCP plan or certified food safety management system
List of intended products and third-country origins
Importer identity document and RCS extract
Common Health Entry Document (CHED) undertaking for border veterinary controls
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If ALVA returns the file with observations, the operator must amend the HACCP plan or storage evidence within the indicated deadline. A refusal may be challenged before the administrative courts; serious non-compliance may require obtaining an establishment approval rather than simple registration.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministère de l'Économie — Direction Générale de l'Autorisation d'Établissement; Administrations vétérinaire et alimentaire (ALVA) for food import operations
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Autorisation d'établissement (commercial wholesale import) and Food Business Operator Registration under Regulation (EC) No 852/2004

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Administration de l'environnement — Ministère de l'Environnement, du Climat et de la Biodiversité
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category: Registration / Exempt for pure wholesale importation. A full EIA report is not mandatory. If the operator maintains a physical cold store, the facility may require an 'établissement classé' operating permit depending on refrigeration capacity and ammonia charge; a simple declaration or category-based authorization will apply under the Law of 22 June 2022 on classified establishments.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater or VOC stack emissions are generated by pure import trading. Any condensate or defrost water must be discharged in accordance with municipal sewer regulations. Refrigeration equipment must comply with the F-Gas Regulation (EU) No 517/2014; ammonia installations above threshold quantities must satisfy the Seveso III Directive and Luxembourg implementing rules. Waste handling, including rejected spoiled product, must follow the waste management regime and be incinerated or rendered through an approved channel.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification for cold-storage premises must be obtained from the Administration des Services de Secours (CGDIS), including evacuation routes, refrigeration alarm, and firefighting equipment. Structural load clearance is required where racking, mezzanine, or heavy cold-chain equipment is installed. Occupational workplace clearance must be coordinated with the Inspection du Travail et des Mines (ITM), covering temperature limits, safe access, machinery guarding, and health surveillance for cold-environment workers.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Administration des contributions directes (ACD) for direct tax identity; Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT) for VAT registration and compliance; unified portal at guichet.lu and MyGuichet.lu.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Prepare the SCSp partnership deed and register the SCSp in the Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register (RCS) through the RCS electronic portal; the RCS registration generates a corporate matricule number. The ACD subsequently allocates the national identification number (matricule d'identification) for income-tax purposes. Before any taxable import, apply to the AEDT for a Luxembourg VAT identification number using the RCS matricule and, if required, obtain an EORI number from Luxembourg Customs for the declaration of imports.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No election is available under Luxembourg law; an SCSp is statutorily transparent and cannot choose opaque corporate taxation. Foreign anti-hybrid rules may force a divergent classification, triggering Luxembourg ATAD and national anti-hybrid provisions, but that does not affect the SCSp's domestic pass-through status.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Luxembourg Value Added Tax (TVA) under the VAT Law of 12 February 1979, implemented in accordance with EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Luxembourg imposes mandatory VAT registration for importers regardless of turnover. The general domestic VAT exemption for small enterprises applies only where annual taxable turnover remains below EUR 35,000; however, importation of goods and traders established outside Luxembourg cannot invoke this exemption and must register and declare import VAT.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Luxembourg does not mandate real-time e-invoicing, fiscal clearance, API stamping, or digital VAT stamping for businesses. E-invoicing is accepted if the invoice's authenticity and integrity are assured. VAT returns and recapitulative statements must be filed electronically through MyGuichet and ACD, while import VAT is assessed and paid via the EU computerised customs declaration system using the SAD format.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero rating is granted when a VAT taxable person supplies goods for dispatch or transport outside the European Union, the risk and ownership pass to the foreign principal, and the export is evidenced by competent documentation. For frozen beef and seafood products, zero rating requires the commodities entered for export to match the invoice and customs declaration exactly, and the export must be completed within the prescribed transport period. Among tied services, international freight and commission services can be zero-rated if covered by the same evidence.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (SAD/EX) bearing the exportation roster or customs stamp
Bill of Lading or equivalent multimodal waybill demonstrating physical receipt in a third-country port
Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT payment confirmation proving repatriation of the export proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: If the export evidence is not received or is found inadequate at audit, the tax authority retrospectively cancels the zero rating and substitutes the standard 17% VAT as at the supply date. Late-payment interest and tax penalties apply, ranging under the Luxembourg VAT law from administrative fines to double the undeclared tax in cases of intentional misstatement; customs law additionally imposes fines and criminal sanctions for false export declarations. The ordinary limitation period for reassessments is five years, extended in the event of fraud.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque centrale du Luxembourg (BCL), operating in the Eurosystem under the European Central Bank (ECB); prudential banking and AML/CFT supervision delegated to the Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The EUR is fully convertible for both current and capital account transactions. Luxembourg imposes no exchange controls and no prior-authorisation requirement on inbound or outbound transfers. For the tax-transparent SCSp, profit allocations to non-resident partners and liquidation proceeds can be remitted freely; no Luxembourg withholding tax arises unless a Luxembourg permanent establishment or deemed commercial activity exists. Only standard BCL statistical balance-of-payments reporting (via resident credit institutions) applies to external flows.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No export-proceeds surrender or mandatory conversion regime exists in Luxembourg. Receipts in foreign currency (USD, GBP, NOK, BRL, ARS) may be held indefinitely in foreign-currency accounts. As this entity is an importer, no conversion obligation attaches; however, the bank must report each external conversion or transfer above the BCL de minimis threshold through the Eurosystem's external transaction statistics framework.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (primary EUR/USD treasury) and Import LC issuing account
Operational Account (SEPA/TARGET2 clearing) and escrow sub-ledger for restricted partner contributions

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Banque et Caisse d'Épargne de l'État (BCEE - Spuerkeess)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account for the locked-in capital buffer against warehouse receipts and regulatory license deposits
Revolving LC Account under the Trade Finance Centre
Secondary Operational Account for USD disbursement to Latin American suppliers
Non-operational private wealth account; asset-coverage collateral account only

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility: LOW for the primary treasury and LC function. Luxembourg-licensed EMIs (CSSF, Law of 10 November 2009) can issue e-money and provide account-to-account transfers, and EEA-passported EMIs can operate cross-border, but none can issue documentary credits or provide pre-shipment commodity trade financing. For this frozen beef/seafood importer, an EMI is limited to ancillary EUR/USD spot conversions and small disbursements after the commercial LC has been settled; it cannot replace a tier-1 bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: De facto mandate: YES. All six tier-1 banks require at least one authorised signatory (typically the managing partner or a director of the corporate general partner) to attend an in-person compliance interview at the Luxembourg branch. Remote video opening is generally refused for a newly registered SCSp unless the GP is an existing banking-group client with signed parental guarantee. Notarised and apostilled copies of the partnership deed and current RCS extract must be delivered physically before the account is activated.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Undisclosed or indirect UBO chain in the SCSp; partner interests held via foreign trusts, foundations, or bearer-like instruments.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete written UBO declaration under the Luxembourg AML Law of 12 November 2004 (as amended); RBE register filing confirmation and extract; full corporate-chain organigram from each qualifying partner to the ultimate natural persons; notarised powers of attorney; source-of-wealth statement per UBO; negative declaration confirming absence of bearer shares or share warrants.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-based money-laundering red flags in frozen-meat commodity flows (over/under-invoicing, cold-chain breakage, split consignments).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete trade file to compliance: executed supply contract with the EC end-buyer; supplier proforma and commercial invoice; packing list; full set clean on-board bills of lading; cold-chain temperature logger printouts; independent inspection certificate (SGS/Cotecna/Bureau Veritas) confirming volume-to-price parity; Luxembourg ASTA veterinary import licence; EU Border Control Post notification and proof of final delivery via CMR/waybill.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk non-EU supplier jurisdictions (Brazil, Argentina, Uruguay, Indonesia) and correspondent-bank opacity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bank-grade OFAC/EU sanctions clearance reports for each transacting party; FATF jurisdiction risk matrix; correspondent-bank SWIFT MT199 KYC replies; LC clause prohibiting transshipment via sanctioned ports; freezing of beneficiary list until treasury staff complete bank-provided AML training; attestation that all documentary collections are routed through the clearing bank's known correspondents.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Pass-through tax classification creating uncertainty for FATCA/CRS reporting and tax-transparency verification.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Opinion letter from a qualified Luxembourg tax counsel confirming the SCSp is transparent and not subject to corporate income tax; CRS registration certificate under EU Regulation 2015/2066 and FATCA registration for pass-through partnerships; partnership agreement demonstrating no Luxembourg commercial activity; clean certificate of residence for the GP and any Luxembourg-domiciled partner.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Start-up SCSp with no historical trading or banking statements.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sponsor's audited financial statements for the most recent two years; corporate guarantee from the sponsor; 12-month liquidity forecast covering drawdown commitments; executed purchase order book or term sheet from a recognised cold-chain logistics provider; confirmation of the statutory licensing pipeline (ASTA import authorisation track record).

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Partner capital injections: SWIFT MT103 from the non-resident partner's bank to the SCSp account at BGL BNP Paribas or BCEE. Field 70 must carry the SCSp's LEI, the notarised contribution deed reference, and the BCL balance-of-payments code for direct investment equity. USD contributions route via BGL's USD clearing account at J.P. Morgan New York, with a corresponding Commerzbank or Intesa Sanpaolo chain for Argentine/Brazilian partners. No exchange-control permit is required; the bank verifies the RCS extract (no minimum capital) and a 12-month flow projection. The bank reports the inflow to BCL external statistics automatically.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary clearing rail: Revolving documentary credit (UCP 600) issued on SWIFT MT700/MT707 by Société Générale Luxembourg or BGL BNP Paribas, available by negotiation at the counters of a confirming bank in the supplier's country (e.g., J.P. Morgan New York or Standard Chartered). Settlement for open-account consignments: SWIFT MT103 with invoice and contract reference. EUR obligations clear through TARGET2; USD obligations through CHIPS/Fedwire via the correspondent bank; exotic currency (BRL/ARS) legs require pre-approval by the bank's FX desk and an identified onshore correspondent. The documentary package must include commercial invoice, full set clean on-board B/L, cold-chain temperature certificate, sanitary/veterinary certificate, ASTA import licence, and EU BCP notification within 21 days after shipment.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright deliverable EUR/USD forward contracts (maturity up to 12 months), fully collateralised by the confirmed LC reimbursement proceeds
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on EUR/BRL and EUR/ARS only where the underlying USD leg is simultaneously covered and a valid FX licence from the local central bank is produced
Cross-currency swaps (one-off zero-coupon EUR/USD swap) executed under ISDA 2002 with a settlement-lag structure matching the LC negotiation dates
OTC EUR/USD options and collars designed to cap the per-consignment USD price escalation on the frozen beef/seafood import programme, with mandatory EMIR trade-repository reporting

Fixed-rate cross-currency basis swaps converting USD LC repayment amounts into EUR aligned with the operating account's drawdown period, subject to the SCSp remaining below the EMIR non-financial-counterparty clearing threshold

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 24.94% aggregate Luxembourg CIT, unemployment-fund surcharge and municipal business tax for a fully taxable resident collective entity based in Luxembourg City; an SCSp is fiscally transparent and is not itself chargeable at this rate.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No tax holiday or preferential deduction applies at the SCSp level because the partnership is a pass-through vehicle; corporate partners include their distributive shares and may benefit from general Luxembourg reliefs only if they satisfy their own conditions (e.g. participation exemption, IP box, treaty relief). The import-wholesale trade in ISIC 4632 does not generate statutory IP or patent income.
